entities.summary: Gerwyn Stephen Price is a Welsh professional darts player and former professional rugby union and rugby league player. He competes in Professional Darts Corporation (PDC) events, where he is ranked world number nine; he was ranked world number one on three occasions from 2021 to 2022. Nicknamed "the Iceman", he won the PDC World Championship in 2021.
